scoring_explanation: Each dimension starts at 100. Every 'error' issue found in that dimension deducts 15 points; every 'warning' deducts 5 points; scores are floored at 0. The overall score is the simple average of the six dimension scores. 0 issue(s) were detected across all dimensions by deterministic checks run against the format rules and the supplied case data (no LLM judging was used for scoring, keeping the score reproducible).
